title: Best way to see key points and understand Barcelona
text:
I have been to Barcelona 5/6 times and have done guided walks ,bus tours and phone guided apps !today was the first time on a tuk tuk ,and by far it was the best trip .samual was passionate about the city and not only gave us a polished guided tour but was open to conversations about the city and even if he wasn’t sure ,wasn’t dismissive to information that he might not have known .
This trip was affordable and very personal ,I would recommend this to anyone I know or anyone that reads this
author: Anton_R

title: Great Tuk-Tuk!
text: Great tour of the city!  Our guide was informative and personable. We’ll be back next year and will enjoy another Tuk-Tuk!
author: Leslie

title: Worth doing!
text: Silivio was a very good tour guide he explained everything thoroughly and takes his time to explain rather than rushing and going and i really appreciate some times he would slowdown the tuk2 so we can properly see it really good also amazing english!!.. the best! and the tour was pretty good as well its great way to see barcelona in a quick way but good amount of places to see then you can just come back to specific places in your extra time… the tour covered actually really good amount of places.. it was truely worth it..
author: Xiara_P

title: Barcelona Tour
text: Great way to see the highlights of Barcelona with an educated tour guide like Marco. Highly recommend this tour especially if you are short on time, very relaxing.
author: Greg_C

title: Jose was fantastic guide!
text: Fabulous 2 hr tour. Jose made it fantastic. Excellent guide and warm & friendly. He gave us so much valuable information.
author: Rochelle_B

title: Fun, fun, fun
text: Our driver Samuel was amazing! Loves his city and was very knowledgeable as well as a great driver. It's a fun was to see Barcelona
author: Charles_E

title: Barcelona eco tuk tuk
text: Great way to get around Barcelona see things and get your bearings to know where to go what to do and see sites you might miss
author: Andrea_D

title: Wonderful tour
text: Christine was wonderful! Enjoyed seeing everything she showed us!  Explained everything to us and showed us a lot of different parts of the city!
author: MaryKay_D

title: Very Enjoyable and Informative!
text: Irene was terrific! Would highly recommend her for any future Tuk Tuk tour.
author: 734gregorya

title: Great Tour of the City
text: Our driver was so very knowledgeable as our all the best parts of Barcelona! Friendly and polite!  Perfect weather for a tultuk tour
